_comment: Policy for the intervention layer (guardian). config/categories.json says WHAT an activity is; this file says HOW each kind is treated. Changes apply when the guardian restarts.

groups._comment: category (from categories.json) -> intervention group. Unlisted categories fall into 'unclassified'.

day._comment: A day runs from startHour to startHour the next morning (05:00 -> 05:00).

streak._comment: Entertainment streak resets after this many consecutive minutes of productive/exercise, or of anything that is not entertainment (incl. idle).

R1._comment: After an R1 ends (closed, or cancelled because the user stayed away until the deadline) R1 rests for reopenWindowMinutes; returning to entertainment meanwhile gets one banner-only re-warning with reopenGraceSeconds.

R2._comment: Checked every minute: fires when today's productive time is below deficitRatio of the usual amount by this time (interpolated within the hour) and the user is not working. After an R2 ends (focus mode ran, or the user started working during grace) it rests for cooldownMinutes; if the user is back off work meanwhile and productive time is still short, one banner-only re-warning with rewarnGraceSeconds follows (closes the 'open the editor for a few seconds' dodge).

webhook._comment: Caps on messages to the agent. R1/R2 skip the per-minute cap (they announce an action about to happen); other messages wait for the minute to pass. The daily cap applies to all.

demo._comment: When enabled, 'overrides' is deep-merged over this file (short values for trying it out; tune for the demo). Also turned on by the env var GUARDIAN_DEMO=1. npm run guardian:trigger -- R2 runs the R2 check right away (demo mode only).
